text:
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=eu-embeddings-prod (high error rate, elevated latency). PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD12345
PagerDuty: Escalation: ENG_ONCALL -> oncall escalation started. Auto-page to rotation.
Jamie: acked. I'm on it. pinging infra metrics.
Mike: also saw the page, taking ownership if Jamie is busy. grabbing logs.
Sasha: I got a customer thread mentioning 504s for embeddings in EU, looks correlated. tagging @Anya for customer comms.
Jamie: timeline: started ~12:42 UTC with a spike in embeddings 5xx and request latency 2s->12s. Graphs show queue depth rising on embedding-workers-eu.
Mike: quick check: curl to health endpoint looks ok from jumpbox but the worker pods have steady errors.
Mike: ```
# from jumphost
curl -s -D - https://eu-embed.redwood.example/health | head -n 10
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"status":"ok","queues":{"embed_queue_depth":172}}
```
Jamie: thanks. attaching a snippet from pod logs that matches the time window:```
2026-02-12T12:41:58Z embed-worker-3 ERROR KVCACHE: prefix miss, queue_size=169
2026-02-12T12:42:05Z embed-worker-5 WARN request timeout 12000ms for model-v1-quant
2026-02-12T12:42:12Z embed-worker-2 ERROR push failed: rpc: connection reset
```
Sasha: looks like kvcache backpressure + transient RPC failures to the model-serving pool. Could be autoscaler not keeping up after a traffic spike.
Lucas: I see a rolling deploy yesterday; might have slightly lower concurrency headroom. Check deployment replicas and HPA.
Mike: checking k8s: current replicas=3, HPA target 50% cpu, current cpu 80%. HPA didn't scale fast enough.
Mike: quick mitigation: recommend scale to 6 replicas and bump max to 10 temporarily. Run: ```kubectl scale deploy embed-workers-eu --replicas=6 -n inference && kubectl patch hpa embed-workers-eu -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":10}}' -n inference```
Jamie: on it. scaling now.
Incident-Bot: Action: deployment embed-workers-eu scaled to 6 replicas (triggered by Jamie).
Mike: after scale, queue depth dropped from 170 -> 40 over ~90s. latency tail improved to ~700ms.
Sasha: customer impact: CS reported ~120 unique requests failed across 3 accounts in the last 10m. Not all customers, but a visible fraction. I'm drafting a short notify to affected customers; @Anya will review.
Anya: saw draft, editing. Will send once we stabilize and have root cause. Please add whether we did a config change or rollback.
Jamie: no config rollback. temporary scale + HPA bump. investigating why HPA didn't react: metrics-server delay?
Lucas: FYI, infra team had a metrics-agent update earlier this week — possible regression in scrape latency. I'll open a ticket.
Mike: also observed some 503s from model-hosts in eu-west-1; attaching sample from model-proxy logs:```
[12:42:10] proxy-7 WARN upstream reset by peer id=10.2.4.12:443
[12:42:11] proxy-3 ERROR connect timeout to model-node-9
```
Jamie: ok, plan: 1) Scale (done). 2) PD note: claim/ack/owner = Mike (primary) / Jamie (support). 3) CS notify draft by Anya after we confirm stability. 4) Postmortem owner Lucas to investigate metrics agent and HPA responsiveness.
PagerDuty: Note added to incident PD12345: "Scale applied to embed-workers-eu -> replicas 6, HPA max 10. Owner: Mike. Stabilized: queue depth decreasing, latency improving."
Sasha: customer comms ready, sending once Mike confirms 10m stable window.
Mike: marking monitoring: queue depth now ~30, 95p latency 850ms, errors back to baseline. I'll keep watching for 15m.
Jamie: small follow-up: we should consider enabling prefix caching TTL relaxation to reduce KV churn for embeddings — added to RCA backlog.
Anya: sent customer note to affected accounts (copied CS-ops). Included mitigation steps and ETA for update.
Incident-Bot: Reminder: when handing off, update PD escalation notes and assign follow-up task.
Sasha: thumbs up. Mike, if you need a hand after 15m call me.
Mike: will do. handing off monitoring to Anya for customer comms post-stable. My status: monitoring until 12:57 UTC.
Anya: acknowledged. taking secondary watch and handling comms. If things reflare, page me or re-open PD.
Lucas: created ticket INF-4921 for metrics-agent investigation and HPA tuning suggestions; assigned to me.
Mike: final quick dump of commands used for audit: ```
kubectl scale deploy embed-workers-eu --replicas=6 -n inference
kubectl patch hpa embed-workers-eu -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":10}}' -n inference
curl -s https://monitoring.example/api/series?query=embed_queue_depth | jq '.data' | head
```
Jamie: thanks. closing active mitigation — leaving PD incident in "monitoring" state. Handing ownership to Lucas for RCA and Anya for customer follow-up.
Anya: acknowledged handoff. Will post a summary to #customer-impact once 30m stable window completes.
Mike: final check-in at 12:58 UTC: metrics stable. marking as resolved if no regression by 13:12 UTC.
Incident-Bot: PD incident PD12345 status: monitoring -> awaiting confirmation.
Jamie: thanks team. good follow-up notes please for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Anya: will consolidate comms + timeline into the postmortem doc after Lucas' RCA.
Lucas: copy. I'll include HPA tuning, metrics-agent rollback options, and a test to simulate embed spikes.
Mike: handing off to Lucas/Anya now. signing off from active page.
Lucas: taking RCA ownership.
Anya: taking customer comms ownership.
Jamie: thread locked to owners. good job everyone.
